*Partnership positions Bowman for continued growth serving critical infrastructure needs across the country*


Bernhard Capital Partners (“Bernhard”) and Bowman Consulting Group Ltd. (“Bowman” or the “Company”) today announced the completion of Bernhard’s previously announced acquisition of Bowman in an all-cash transaction valued at approximately $1 billion. With this closing, Bowman becomes a privately held company backed by Bernhard, beginning a new chapter of investment and growth for the national engineering services firm. Bowman’s common stock has ceased trading and will be delisted from Nasdaq.


The acquisition brings together Bowman’s technical capabilities, client relationships, and national reach with Bernhard’s deep industry expertise and track record supporting the growth of critical infrastructure services businesses. Together, Bernhard and Bowman will pursue opportunities to build on the Company’s established strategy of organic growth and strategic acquisitions, expand its technical capabilities, and strengthen its presence across key infrastructure markets.


“Bowman has built a well-established business by bringing together talented people, investing in technical expertise and delivering results,” said Mark Spender, Partner and Chief Investment Officer at Bernhard. “As clients take on larger and more complex infrastructure projects, they increasingly need partners who can deliver across multiple disciplines and geographies. Bowman’s breadth of capabilities and national reach position it well for continued growth, and we look forward to supporting the team as it strengthens its ability to serve clients across the country.”


“Today marks the start of an exciting new chapter for Bowman and the people who have helped build and grow this company,” said Gary Bowman, Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Bowman. “Bernhard understands our business and shares our conviction in the opportunities ahead. For 30 years, Bowman has methodically grown into a national business, and I could not be prouder of what our team has accomplished together. In Bernhard, we have found a partner that respects the entrepreneurial culture that has made Bowman successful and will build on that foundation for years to come. With their support, Bowman will continue investing in its people, bringing new expertise into the organization, and delivering with responsiveness and technical excellence for our clients.”


**Advisors**


BofA Securities served as exclusive financial advisor and Latham & Watkins LLP served as legal counsel to Bowman, and Collected Strategies served as strategic communications advisor. Kirkland & Ellis LLP served as legal counsel to Bernhard.


**About Bernhard**


Bernhard Capital Partners is a private markets investment firm focused on infrastructure services and infrastructure assets. Bernhard combines investment discipline with sector knowledge and operating experience to help businesses improve performance, expand their capabilities and grow.
